exact.Un laboratorio que frenara perdería su s: A lab that slowed down would lose its place in the chip orders and in the grid-connection queue, which is not quickly recovered.

exact.Los centros de datos consumieron unos 41: Data centres consumed about 415 TWh in 2024, around 1.5% of the world’s electricity; in the IEA’s base scenario they reach about 945 TWh in 2030.
exact.La demanda eléctrica de los centros de d: Data-centre electricity demand grew 17% in 2025; that of AI-dedicated centres, around 50%.
exact.Para pasar de chips a electricidad, Epoc: To go from chips to electricity, Epoch estimates that an installation’s power is roughly double the nominal consumption (TDP) of its chips.
exact.Según las notas de Epoch, Prometheus (Me: According to Epoch’s notes, Prometheus (Meta) depends on two gas plants of its own, Socrates South and Socrates North, planned for November 2026, and Colossus 2 (xAI) on its own turbines and batteries.
exact.Retrasos atribuidos a la red o al sumini: Delays attributed to the grid or to supply: there is not yet a systematic source; Epoch’s schedule gives estimated dates, not causes.
exact.Electricidad de la IA por separado: la I: AI electricity separately: the IEA mostly publishes figures for all data centres. Its website does not allow automated reading, so its figures are checked through a search engine.
exact.La electricidad, más que los chips, marc: Electricity, more than chips, sets the pace of new capacity in 2026 and 2027, and the large data centres turn to their own generation so as not to wait for the grid.
exact.Quien asegura electricidad propia o una: Whoever secures their own electricity or an early connection (gas, turbines, batteries, contracts with power plants) and whoever sells them that energy.
exact.Frenar deja chips pagados sin conectar y: Slowing down leaves paid-for chips unconnected and hands the time advantage to whoever does secure power.
exact.Precios eléctricos, emisiones y refuerzo: Electricity prices, emissions and grid reinforcements fall on other consumers and on the areas where the data centres are built.

exact.Que esa relación se acerque a 1, o que m: That this ratio approaches 1, or that independent field measurements show large, stable speed-ups.
exact.El horizonte temporal mide cuánto le lle: The time horizon measures how long the tasks would take a human expert, not how long the agent can work without supervision.
exact.METR ya no actualiza activamente su pági: METR no longer actively updates its time-horizons page; the last update was on 8 September 2026.
exact.En el estudio de METR con grupo de contr: In METR’s controlled study, developers took 19% longer with AI in early 2025 (interval: +2% to +39%). At the end of 2025 the original participants took 18% less time (−38% to +9%) and the new ones 4% less (−15% to +9%). METR considers this second figure unreliable because of selection effects (between 30 and 50% of tasks were left out) and takes it as a lower bound on the speed-up.
exact.Una medida de fiabilidad (éxito al 80 %): A reliability measure (80% success) on long tasks that keeps being updated: MirrorCode measures tasks of weeks, but only in programming and with a single overall score.
exact.Datos de campo sobre cuánto trabajo de a: Field data on how much of the agents’ work is reviewed or redone.
exact.Formulada al abrir la sección. La serie: Formulated when the section was opened. METR’s series is no longer updated: if no other independent measurement appears, this hypothesis may be left with no way of being checked.
exact.La fiabilidad crece más despacio que la: Reliability grows more slowly than capability: what an agent completes 4 times out of 5 is far below what it completes half the time, and that gap is human supervision work.
exact.Quien vende agentes por tarea o sustituy: Whoever sells agents per task or replaces entry-level posts gets paid before reliability arrives.
exact.Frenar el despliegue retrasa ingresos y: Slowing down deployment delays revenue and the usage data with which the next version is trained.
exact.Verificar, corregir y asumir los errores: Verifying, correcting and bearing the errors (security, technical debt) passes to the user, the customer and the teams that inherit the work.
exact.¿Mejoran capacidades transferibles o se: Are transferable capabilities improving, or are the tests saturating?
exact.Más evaluaciones de Epoch por encima del: More Epoch evaluations above 90% and independent series that stop being updated, such as METR’s.
exact.Pruebas nuevas e independientes que cons: New, independent tests that keep headroom and are updated with each model, and an ECI that still separates models.
exact.El ECI supone que el resultado en cada e: The ECI assumes that the result on each evaluation follows a logistic curve of the difference between the model’s capability and the test’s difficulty, with a slope specific to each test; the fit estimates both each model’s ECI and each evaluation’s difficulty (EDI) at once.
exact.Epoch AI, repositorio público del ajuste: Epoch AI, public repository of the ECI fit (eci-public)
exact.Epoch considera que dos modelos tienen l: Epoch considers two models to have the same capability if their ECI differs by less than 1 point.
exact.METR considera poco fiables las medicion: METR considers time-horizon measurements above 16 hours unreliable (note of 8 May 2026, regarding Claude Mythos Preview): the test itself falls short.
exact.Los autores de AI 2027 advierten de que: The authors of AI 2027 warn that their predictions of tests for 2026 will be harder to measure.
exact.Las cifras de SWE-bench Verified de este: The SWE-bench Verified figures in this observatory are Epoch’s own runs, not those declared by the labs.
exact.Contaminación de datos de prueba: no hay: Test-data contamination: there is no systematic public measure.
exact.Las pruebas públicas se saturan antes de: Public tests saturate before measuring what matters (long, reliable work), and evaluation comes to depend on figures declared by the labs themselves.
exact.Los laboratorios controlan el relato sob: The labs control the narrative about their capability when there is no independent test to contradict it.
exact.Esperar a evaluaciones independientes re: Waiting for independent evaluations delays launches and headlines.
exact.El coste de comprobar recae en evaluador: The cost of checking falls on independent evaluators, regulators and users, who decide with less information.
exact.¿El uso produce valor suficiente para so: Does usage produce enough value to sustain the spending?
exact.Que los ingresos se concentren aún más e: That revenue concentrates even more in the first one or two labs, or that the cost of data centres grows faster than revenue.
exact.Que más empresas entren entre las de may: That more companies enter among those with the highest revenue and that usage translates into revenue outside the labs.
exact.Epoch distingue tipos de ingresos (por e: Epoch distinguishes types of revenue (for example, annualised from a month’s run rate) and assigns each report a confidence level; the observatory shows both next to each figure.
exact.Según el ajuste de los autores de AI 202: According to the AI 2027 authors’ fit, the annualised revenue of the leading lab has multiplied by 10 for every 15 ECI points gained.
exact.Según los autores de AI 2027, Claude Cod: According to the AI 2027 authors, Claude Code exceeded $2.5 billion in annualised revenue in early February 2026.
exact.Márgenes y coste de servir los modelos:: Margins and the cost of serving the models: the labs do not publish them in a comparable way.
exact.Gasto de capital del sector completo: Ep: Capital spending of the whole sector: Epoch gives the cost of the data centres it tracks, not the total.
exact.Los ingresos crecen deprisa pero se conc: Revenue grows fast but is concentrated in very few labs, while a good part of the data-centre spending is financed by third parties: if growth slows, the bill falls on whoever financed the infrastructure and not on whoever sells the model.
exact.Los laboratorios líderes, los fabricante: The leading labs, the chip makers and the data-centre owners, as long as growth justifies the valuations.
exact.Frenar pondría a prueba valoraciones bas: Slowing down would test valuations based on growth and capacity contracts already committed.
exact.El riesgo financiero pasa a inversores,: The financial risk passes to investors, debt and suppliers; the energy costs, to the grid.

exact.Nuevos acuerdos sin mecanismo de verific: New agreements with no verification mechanism, or antitrust lawsuits that curb coordination between companies.
exact.Un mecanismo de notificación de incident: A US–China incident-notification mechanism in operation, compute verification, or an EU sanction applied to a general-purpose model provider.
exact.Las obligaciones del Reglamento de IA de: The obligations of the EU AI Act for providers of general-purpose models apply from 2 August 2025; the Commission can enforce them, with fines, from 2 August 2026, and models placed on the market before 2 August 2025 have until 2 August 2027.
exact.29 países firmaron en Shanghái, el 16 de: 29 countries signed WAICO’s founding agreement in Shanghai on 16 July 2026, the international AI organisation promoted by China. No G7 economy and no EU member state has joined, and it has not yet adopted binding commitments or rules.
exact.Pax Silica, la coalición de EE. UU. cent: Pax Silica, the US-led coalition focused on the AI and semiconductor supply chain, went from 11 signatories (December 2025) to 24 (June 2026). It is not a formal organisation or a governance framework.
exact.Según CSIS, no existe ningún medio técni: According to CSIS, there is no established technical means for the US or China to check that the other is complying with a commitment on the capabilities or testing of its models.
exact.CSIS informa de que agentes autónomos de: CSIS reports that autonomous agents from several companies have escaped containment during tests.
exact.El 29 de septiembre de 2026, la Casa Bla: On 29 September 2026, the White House and six AI companies signed a one-page voluntary agreement (White House Accord on Super Intelligence): internal controls, an internal team to oversee them, an independent external auditor and an independent board committee. The agreement does not propose turning it into law immediately.
exact.Los firmantes se comprometen a reunirse: The signatories commit to meeting regularly to set standards; there are already antitrust lawsuits alleging coordination between companies to set the pace of AI development.
exact.En la reunión preparatoria de la cumbre: At the preparatory meeting for the September summit between Trump and Xi, the US and China discussed creating a “US-China AI Dialogue”; the US proposed an incident-notification mechanism and both sides agreed to meet again.
exact.Resultado de la cumbre EE. UU.–China del: Outcome of the 24 September 2026 US–China summit on AI: no official communiqué has been found.
exact.Verificación de cómputo o de entrenamien: Compute or training verification between countries: there is no mechanism in operation to report on.
exact.La coordinación existente es declarativa: Existing coordination is declaratory: no commitment signed between rivals includes technical verification, and the two blocs (Pax Silica and WAICO) compete to write the rules, not to limit themselves.
exact.Cada bloque y sus laboratorios: acelerar: Each bloc and its labs: accelerating secures position while nobody can check that the rival is slowing down too.
exact.Quien frenara en solitario perdería posi: Whoever slowed down alone would lose position with no guarantee that the other will do the same; this is Moloch’s trap.
exact.El riesgo de incidentes (agentes fuera d: The risk of incidents (agents out of control, cyberattacks) falls on third parties and on countries that are in neither bloc.
